design: From scratch, NO warm start: dense vs MoE (learned gate), 10764 steps = one epoch on tokens-v4, seed 5489 both arms, --ddp 2 one board, 22 validation points each. Paired: identical data order, so per-step oscillation cancels.
why_this_run_exists: The four-arm warm-started experiment could not answer whether MoE overtakes dense: every MoE arm carried 204 fresh parameters against a converged feed-forward, so the whole dense-vs-MoE gap was initialization debt. From scratch there is no debt and the comparison is of architectures.
verdict: MoE lower (better) than dense; effect grows over training.
honest_reading: MoE here has 3.62x TOTAL parameters at 0.989x ACTIVE compute, so this is the ordinary MoE bargain -- more parameters for the same compute helped. It is NOT evidence about die geography: gate policy was measured separately in the four-arm run, where seeding the gate from the die map bought nothing measurable (+0.0044 nats, signs 8+/7-) and freezing it to physical address cost only 0.0118.
caveat: Superseded by `replication`: the original single-seed caveat is resolved. Two seeds, same direction, same trajectory shape.

replication.reading: Both seeds favour MoE, both significant, and the TRAJECTORY SHAPE reproduced independently: each run starts near zero (seed 8191 slightly negative) and ends near +0.06. A seed artefact would be unlikely to reproduce indifferent-early / separating-late twice. The effect is smaller at 8191 (0.0354 vs 0.0481), so treat ~0.04 as the estimate rather than the larger first number.
replication.what_this_does_not_establish: Still the ordinary MoE bargain: 3.62x total parameters at 0.989x active compute. Nothing here is evidence about die-region routing, which measured nearly null separately. And two seeds is two, not a distribution — the pooled |t| of 8.0 describes item-level variance across 44 validation points, not run-to-run variance across many runs.
replication.run_to_run_context: For scale: two DENSE runs differing only in seed show mean |delta| 0.0495 on absolute validation loss. That is UNPAIRED and still contains the per-step oscillation the paired design cancels, so it is not comparable to the paired effect above — but it does mean any claim about ABSOLUTE loss at this scale needs more than one run.
